title: Pan-Fried Samphire with Brined Shrimp
description: A simple yet flavorful dish that combines the freshness of samphire with the savory taste of brined shrimp.
instructions: Rinse the samphire under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the brined shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Add the samphire to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with lemon juice.
